description: Run shell steps in a sandbox. The workdir is saved after each step; when the box dies, its provider refuses, or it runs out of time or free credit, the job continues on another box from the last saved step. Waits up to waitSec for the end, then returns the state, where it ran, how often it moved, and the output of the last step that succeeded and of the step that failed it, if one did. A job still running then goes on: poll job_status with its id.

files.description: Initial workspace: path under the workdir → UTF-8 content

sandbox.description: Where the boxes go (same fields as create_sandbox)

avoid.description: Provider ids to rank last within their lane

execTimeoutSec.description: Longest single command, in seconds; providers that cut commands off sooner are skipped

image.description: OCI image, e.g. python:3.12-slim (only providers that run custom images)

minIsolation.description: Weakest isolation to accept (container < gvisor < microvm = vm); weaker or unknown providers are skipped

os.description: Operating system (default linux); providers running another OS are skipped

prefer.description: Provider ids to rank first within their lane

strategy.description: Routing strategy from list_strategies (default: the configured one)

setup.description: Run on every new box before the workspace is restored (installs); must be safe to repeat

idempotent.description: false when running it twice would repeat an outside effect (deploy, payment, message)

noCheckpoint.description: Skip saving the workspace after it (read-only steps such as tests)

retries.description: Extra attempts when it exits non-zero (default 0)

run.description: Shell command, run in the workdir

steps.description: Run in order; a step is the unit of retry

waitSec.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end before answering (default 45, at most 600). A job still running then goes on; poll job_status.

workdir.description: Carried from box to box; relative paths are under $HOME (default "work")

name: run_job
